disposition_reason: Prints site means with SD and pooled means and ranges for six elements in melon-seed cake and groundnut cake snacks from Abeokuta motor parks.

study.design: Market survey: snack cakes bought weekly for seven weeks from vendors at seven motor parks, with production-center controls
study.origin: Locally prepared melon-seed and groundnut cakes, Abeokuta area, Ogun State, Nigeria
study.market: Vendors and hawkers at seven motor parks in Abeokuta (Asero, Adatan, Sapon, Ita-oshin, Lafenwa, Itoku, Kuto); controls from production centers
study.method: Oven drying 105 °C, dry ashing 450 °C, 5M HNO3 digestion, flame AAS (Buck 210A)
study.qa: Reagent blanks; acid-washed glassware; no CRM or recovery reported
